verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee's API is path-versioned (/api/v1), and the docs carry an inline deprecation notice for query-string API keys, which stay supported for backward compatibility. That is versioning plus one documented deprecation, not a general deprecation policy. Missing for 10: a standalone versioning/deprecation-policy page with timelines or sunset guarantees, a changelog (/changelog/ returns 404), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: The API is path-versioned (base https://app.scrapingbee.com/api/v1) with a documented, backward-compatible deprecation
The `api_key` query parameter remains supported for backward compatibility but is deprecated for new integrations.
